streams: disjoint training/calibration/evaluation seeds; evaluation prior families share exogenous arrays by nuisance-index and gap-index; R1 is the first frame of each R16 group
independence: 4096 training frames; 384 independent null calibration groups of 16; 384 independent evaluation groups of 16 shared by three prior families (18432 resulting observed vectors)
truth_boundary: working training parameters fixed before simulation; known-nuisance arm receives declared statistical tau/noise; unknown arm receives only observed features; gap and realized latent variables used only by generator and external scorer
negative_result_rule: retain every grid case, boundary fit, unidentifiable second-order baseline and G0 plateau mismatch; no successful-subset scoring
threshold_scope: empirical calibration at three registered nuisance points only, no uniform continuous-domain false-alarm guarantee
timing: complete development diagnostic costs including simulation, transforms, covariance, bank construction, calibration and all fits; no deployment latency claim
